Jinshui Gate
landmark

Acest punct de reper arhitectural tradițional reprezintă una dintre vechile intrări istorice în oraș.
This traditional architectural landmark represents one of the ancient historical entryways into the city.
Xīsī Square Night Market
landmark
Am Abend verwandelt sich dieser Platz in ein lebhaftes Marktviertel voller lokaler Essensverkäufer und beleuchteter Stände.

Seara, această piațetă se transformă într-o zonă de piață plină de viață, cu vânzători locali de mâncare și tarabe iluminate.
In the evening, this square transforms into a lively market area packed with local food vendors and illuminated stalls.
Bei Tan
historical
Dieses steinerne Denkmal ist ein dauerhaftes Gedenkbauwerk, das die traditionelle chinesische Zeremonialgeschichte widerspiegelt.
Ez a kőből készült emlékmű egy tartós megemlékező építmény, amely a hagyományos kínai ceremoniális történelmet tükrözi.
Acest monument din piatră stă drept o structură comemorativă durabilă ce reflectă istoria ceremonială tradițională chineză.
This stone monument stands as a lasting commemorative structure reflecting traditional Chinese ceremonial history.
Pota Pagoda
tower
Diese bemerkenswerte sechseckige Backsteinpagode zeichnet sich durch ein Äußeres aus, das mit Tausenden von kleinen, detaillierten buddhistischen Schnitzereien bedeckt ist.

Această remarcabilă pagodă hexagonală din cărămidă are un exterior acoperit cu mii de mici sculpturi budiste detaliate.
This notable hexagonal brick pagoda features an exterior covered with thousands of small, detailed Buddhist carvings.
Kaifeng Museum
museum
Dieses bemerkenswerte städtische Museum präsentiert eine große Sammlung regionaler Artefakte und legt den Schwerpunkt auf das goldene Zeitalter der Stadt während der Song-Dynastie.
Ez a jelentős városi múzeum regionális műtárgyak nagy gyűjteményét mutatja be, hangsúlyt fektetve a város Song-dinasztia alatti aranykorára.
Acest muzeu civic notabil expune o colecție vastă de artefacte regionale, subliniind epoca de aur a orașului din timpul dinastiei Song.
This notable civic museum showcases a large collection of regional artifacts, emphasizing the city's golden era during the Song Dynasty.
China Hanyuan Garden
landmark
Dieser Kulturgarten ist berühmt für seinen weitläufigen „Stelenwald“, in dem Tausende gravierter Steintafeln mit chinesischer Kalligraphie ausgestellt sind.
Ez a kulturális kert kiterjedt "sztéléerdőjéről" híres, amely több ezer, kínai kalligráfiával gravírozott kőtáblát mutat be.
Această grădină culturală este faimoasă pentru "pădurea sa de stele", expunând mii de tablete din piatră gravate cu caligrafie chineză.
This cultural garden is famous for its extensive "stele forest," displaying thousands of engraved stone tablets of Chinese calligraphy.
Millennium City Park
recreational

This immersive historical theme park brings the famous Song Dynasty painting "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" to life through elaborate recreations.
Fanlou Building
landmark

This grand multi-story architectural complex recreates one of the most famous and luxurious tavern buildings of the ancient Song Dynasty.
Tianbo Yang General's Mansion
landmark

This memorial complex honors the legendary military exploits of the Yang family generals with its traditional courtyards and weaponry displays.
Former Henan Provincial Museum
museum

Established in 1927, this nationally protected level 2 heritage site preserves the classic architecture of the original provincial museum.

museum

This biographical exhibition hall is dedicated to documenting the historical political events surrounding the statesman Liu Shaoqi's time in Kaifeng.
Liuqingxia Former Residence
museum

This preserved courtyard complex serves as a museum detailing the life and patriotic contributions of the historical figure Liu Qingxia.
Kaifeng Sacred Heart Cathedral
religious

This notable Catholic cathedral stands out with its distinct architectural style among the city's traditional buildings.
Kaifeng East Mosque
religious

Recognized as a notable Islamic center, this large mosque beautifully incorporates classic Chinese architectural elements into its design.
Drum Tower

Positioned as a prominent historical landmark, this imposing tower structure once played a crucial role in traditional civic timekeeping.
Shanxi-Shaanxi-Gansu Guild Hall
museum

Built in 1765, this level 2 heritage site features exquisite traditional wood carvings that once served merchants from three provinces.
Daxiangguo Temple
religious
Dieser höchst bemerkenswerte buddhistische Tempelkomplex ist historisch berühmt und zentriert sich um eine bekannte Statue, die aus einem einzigen Ginkgobaum geschnitzt wurde.

Kaifeng Governor's Mansion
landmark

This restored historical administrative complex features traditional yamen architecture where ancient civic officials once governed the region.
Kaifeng Museum
museum

Yanqing Taoist Temple
religious

Bao Zheng's Memorial Hall
landmark

Set by a lake, this well-known memorial hall honors the legacy of Lord Bao, a deeply revered Song Dynasty official famous for his righteous judgments.
Daliang Gate
landmark

Yuwangtai Park
park

This notable historical park features an ancient elevated terrace dedicated to Yu the Great's legendary flood control achievements.
Iron Pagoda
landmark

Diese Kulturerbestätte der Stufe 2 wurde im Jahr 1049 erbaut und ist ein hoch aufragendes achteckiges Meisterwerk, das vollständig mit rostfarbenen glasierten Ziegeln verkleidet ist, die massivem Eisen ähneln.

Constructed in 1049, this level 2 heritage site is a towering octagonal masterpiece completely clad in rust-colored glazed bricks that resemble solid iron.

landmark
